note: Adapted from the species description of Speculitermes sinhalensis in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; all three castes are present, and a further account of biology (galleries, swarming season, soldier proportion) is not included for reasons of length; synonymy citations, figure references and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, with a pale yellow stripe on each side running from the frons backwards and converging, sometimes indistinct; antennae brown; mandibles dark brown; labrum pale yellow; thorax, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head and thorax sparsely pilose, abdomen moderately pilose. Total body length 6.5-8.2 mm. Head subquadrate, in lateral view flattened and sloping forward anteriorly (length to mandible base 2.3-2.6 mm, maximum width 1.8-1.93 mm, width/length ratio 0.74-0.83). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and not completely separated. Postclypeus pale yellow, sparsely pilose, divided into two halves by a fine and incomplete line; anteclypeus thin, glabrous, band-shaped. Labrum broadly ligulate or hemispherical (length 0.33-0.40, width 0.50-0.53 mm), with a few setae near the anterior margin. Mandibles stout and long, strongly incurved from the apical third (length 1.47-1.50 mm), slightly longer than half the head length, mandible length/head length ratio 0.58-0.65; each mandible with a large, forwardly directed triangular tooth at one-third of the mandibular length from the apex, tooth distance/mandible length ratio 0.31-0.33 on the left mandible and 0.35 on the right. Postmentum long, rod-shaped, slightly constricted at the waist; anterior margin with 2 setae on each side, wider anterior part with several short hairs; length 1.47-1.60 mm, maximum width 0.50-0.60 mm, width at waist 0.33-0.43 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins without a median notch; anterior margin with a row of short hairs, the edge also with several longer setae; length 0.57-0.63 mm, maximum width 0.93-1.03 mm. Mesonotum slightly narrower (width 0.77-0.83 mm), metanotum slightly wider (1.0-1.18 mm). Legs slender and pilose; tibial spur formula 3:2:2 or 2:2:2, dorsal spur of the fore leg reduced or sometimes absent. Abdomen elongate, moderately pilose, tergites and sternites weakly sclerotized.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brown to greyish brown; postclypeus, antennae and labrum paler; body and legs translucent white. Head sparsely pilose, body moderately pilose. Total body length about 4.5-6.3 mm. Head subcircular (length to mandible base 1.05-1.17 mm, maximum width 1.25-1.40 mm); with a V-shaped suture; a small circular mid-dorsal spot at the junction of the V-shaped suture, diameter 0.07-0.11 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, rod-shaped and subdivided. Postclypeus raised and pilose, half as long as wide (length 0.29-0.33 mm, width 0.60-0.66 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.37-0.40 mm, width 0.77-0.83 mm).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule nearly black, with a pale crescent-shaped spot on each side between the ocellus and the postclypeus; antennae and labrum brown; postclypeus and pronotum dark brown; wings brown; legs yellowish brown to brown; tergites dark brown, sternites brown and paler medially. Head capsule densely pilose, with many small hairs and several long setae; body more densely pilose, hairs longer. Total body length 15.0-16.9 mm with wings, 7.2-9.4 mm without wings. Head subcircular, wider than long (length to mandible base 1.10-1.20 mm, width including compound eyes 1.43-1.63 mm); area of the mid-dorsal spot slightly depressed; mid-dorsal spot very small, circular. Compound eyes subcircular, diameter 0.37-0.40 mm. Ocelli suboval, translucent (long diameter 0.17-0.18 mm, short diameter 0.11-0.13 mm), separated from the compound eye by about half their long diameter (eye-ocellus distance 0.05-0.11 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, occasionally 16-segmented, segment 3 shortest (this segment subdivided in 16-segmented individuals). Postclypeus with long and short hairs, slightly longer than half its width (length 0.38-0.40 mm, width 0.68-0.73 mm). Labrum broad, ligulate, truncate medially on the anterior margin (length 0.33-0.38 mm, width 0.57-0.66 mm). Pronotum dark brown, with a dark spot below the anterior margin and a pale line running longitudinally through the middle; wider than long and narrower than head (length 0.73-0.87 mm, width 1.30-1.43 mm); anterior margin weakly emarginate, without notches; posterior margin rounded with a deep median notch. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum with a deep median notch. Wings brown, transparent; fore wing entirely pilose, hind wing pilose only apically; fore wing including scales 13.1-14.7 mm long, hind wing 12.2-13.2 mm; wing membrane with non-stellate spinules, each with 1-3 arms, size 5-12 μm × 2-5 μm, density 3850/mm².
